references.text: In John 18:1, Jesus again goes to the Mount of Olives, this time with his disciples before he is arrested, creating a clear parallel to the movement in 8:1.
Mark 14:26 describes Jesus and his disciples going to the Mount of Olives after the Last Supper, an event that shares the same geographical motif and movement as in John 8:1.
Luke 22:39 confirms that Jesus had a habit of going to the Mount of Olives, providing context for why he also went there in John 8:1.
